record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: If a graph cocycle γ generates the formal flow P(ε)=exp(ε O→r(γ)(P)·∂/∂P⃗)P|_{ε=0} on Poisson bi-vectors, does that graph-defined power series converge and determine a globally well-defined Poisson structure at every point of an arbitrary affine Poisson manifold?

evidence.quote: Problem 8. Does the formal power series expansion P(ε) using graphs determine a globally well defined Poisson structure at all points of arbitrary affine Poisson manifold (M^r_aff,P) ? In other words, do the power series converge (uniformly over M^r_aff) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $M$ be an affine Poisson manifold of dimension $r$, that is, a manifold $M^r_{\mathrm{aff}}$ equipped with an atlas whose transition maps are affine, together with a Poisson bi-vector field $P\in\Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)$ satisfying the Jacobi identity $[\![P,P]\!]=0$ in the Schouten bracket. Let $\gamma$ be a cocycle in the Kontsevich graph complex (a finite linear combination of unoriented graphs on $n$ internal vertices, modulo signs from edge orderings, that is closed under the vertex-expansion differential). Associated with $\gamma$ is the orientation morphism $\vec{\mathrm{Or}}(\gamma)(P)$, a bi-vector whose coefficients are universal differential polynomials in the components of $P$, obtained by summing over all admissible orientations of $\gamma$ on two sinks and inserting a copy of $P$ at every internal vertex. Because $\gamma$ is a cocycle, the assignment $\dot P=\vec{\mathrm{Or}}(\gamma)(P)$ defines an infinitesimal deformation that preserves the Poisson property to first order in a formal parameter $\varepsilon$.

Consider the formal flow
$$P(\varepsilon)=\exp\!\Big(\varepsilon\,\vec{\mathrm{Or}}(\gamma)(P)\cdot\frac{\partial}{\partial \vec P}\Big)P\,\Big|_{\varepsilon=0}\;\in\;\Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)[\![\varepsilon]\!],$$
viewed as a formal power series in $\varepsilon$ with coefficients that are differential-polynomial expressions in the components of $P$.

Question. For an arbitrary affine Poisson manifold $(M^r_{\mathrm{aff}},P)$, does the formal power series $P(\varepsilon)$ converge—uniformly on $M^r_{\mathrm{aff}}$, in a suitable topology on bi-vector fields—on a nontrivial interval of values of $\varepsilon$, so that for each such $\varepsilon$ it determines a globally well-defined Poisson bi-vector field on $M$?
artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph complex and Poisson geometry
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (2024–2025) in the series "Kontsevich graphs act on Nambu–Poisson brackets" continue to list convergence of the graph-defined exponential flow on (Nambu–)Poisson bi-vectors as an open problem; no general convergence result for arbitrary affine Poisson manifolds has been established. Existing results address formal-series-level cocycle properties and specific examples, not global convergence.

status_evidence.title: Kontsevich graphs act on Nambu–Poisson brackets, VI. Open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems regarding Kontsevich graph flows on Poisson and Nambu–Poisson brackets, including convergence of the formal exponential flow.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence of the graph-defined formal flow on Poisson structures is still listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Poisson brackets symmetry from the pentagon-wheel cocycle in the graph complex
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of infinitesimal Poisson deformations from graph cocycles via the orientation morphism on affine Poisson manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The graph-cocycle construction yields formal flows whose convergence on affine Poisson manifolds is not addressed.
